On January 29, 2026, the Turkish Football Federation issued a fine of 802,500 Turkish lira (approximately $18,500) to Amed S.F.K. (Amedspor) for "damaging the reputation of football" by making "ideological propaganda." Additionally, the club's president, Nahit Eren, was suspended from football-related activities for 15 days.
